facts.fact: 日记作者把 CIA 说成彻头彻尾的女性，先把她比作跳扇子舞的舞女。
facts.anchor: CIA, she’s female all the way. She’s a fan dancer.

facts.fact: 他称 CIA 是令人恼火、可能疯癫的情妇，什么也不承认、什么都否认，还要反咬一口。
facts.anchor: She’s an infuriating, possibly crazy, mistress. She admits nothing, denies everything, and makes counter-accusations.

facts.fact: 他说 CIA 看起来像二十出头、身体柔软的年轻人，并补了一句“至少在局部”。
facts.anchor: But clearly she’s a young, supple twenty-something, at least in parts.

facts.fact: 叙述者请“梅菲斯特”看一份不完整的名单，说这些都是被 CIA 诱向死亡的可怜人。
facts.anchor: Don’t believe me, Mephistopheles? Well just stop and consider this partial list of some of the poor, naive folks CIA has managed to lure straight to their deaths:

facts.fact: 死亡名单里出现了肯尼迪总统的全名。
他说爱上 CIA 就像爱上一个妓女，一个六十九岁的荷兰妓女。
facts.anchor: Falling in love with the Agency is like falling in love with a prostitute. A 69-year-old prostitute. A 69-year-old Dutch prostitute.

facts.fact: 他认为想让 CIA 改邪归正，就像想让 CIA 简报员向国会监督委员会坦白一样不可能。
facts.anchor: Trying to make her go straight is like trying to get a CIA briefer to come clean to a Congressional Oversight Committee.

facts.fact: 他明说 CIA 六十九岁，而且已经被人用得旧了。
facts.anchor: She’s 69 years old. And she’s well-used.
